title: LSRP: A Leader–Subordinate Retrieval Framework for Privacy-Preserving Cloud–Device Collaboration

problem.claim: Existing cloud-device collaboration approaches underuse on-cloud LLM problem-solving capabilities and inadequately integrate personalized user data into on-device SLM responses.

gap.claim: Existing approaches do not fully align on-cloud LLM capabilities with personalized user-task needs or provide sufficient contextual user information to on-device SLMs.

contributions.claim: The paper proposes LSRP, a Leader–Subordinate Retrieval framework for privacy-preserving cloud-device collaboration.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors describe LSRP as a novel solution that bridges the identified cloud-device collaboration gaps.

narrative_sequence.summary: Cloud-device collaboration combines on-cloud LLMs for public queries with on-device SLMs for private user data.
Existing approaches insufficiently exploit cloud LLM capabilities and personalized on-device data, causing task-alignment and contextual-information mismatches.
The paper introduces LSRP to bridge these gaps.
